ValidationRule.description: Only the user who created the request or a System Administrator / PKR admin can change the Approver of an approval.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Approver__c), NOT(ISNEW()), $User.Id <> Part_Code_Request__r.CreatedById, $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", NOT($Permission.PKR_Deploy_Products) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only the user who created the request or a System Administrator can assign the approver.
